card.text: Explore Kleopatra’s two lobes and narrow neck with its published shape model.

introduction.text: Kleopatra is a main-belt asteroid with two broad lobes joined by a narrow neck. Its dog-bone shape was reconstructed from VLT/SPHERE images and complementary observations. Explore that published model under directional lighting; the grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: SPHERE shape reconstruction
shape.summary: A VLT/SPHERE shape model showing two lobes and a narrow neck. Gray grid: no surface imagery, not composition.
